prompts.primary:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: one blank reusable medieval strategy game action button.
Primary request: reproduce the exact restrained style of the small Build / Fortify / Clear / Forbid buttons in the user's narrow 314x378 reference. A single horizontally rectangular blank button, aspect ratio 1.5:1. Deep near-black charcoal teal slate face (#141f20), extremely quiet subtle surface. Warm antique gold thin double bevel frame, with a fine inner gold line, tiny chamfered corners and tiny warm top-left edge highlights. At final 80x54 px the entire frame is only 3px thick. Outer very dark shadow below, small and close.
Composition: straight-on orthographic flat UI texture. Entire rectangle visible, centered, almost fills canvas with a small even transparent margin. All exterior around button genuinely transparent. Center inside button opaque.
No text, letters, icons, symbols, runes, ornament, flourishes, finials, bolts, illustrations, map, wood, bright yellow glow, or scene. No perspective. No labels. Do not make large decorative corner pieces. Thin restrained antique brass geometry, dark teal face. Sharp corners with only tiny diagonal chamfers.
prompts.compact:

A small fine light gold highlight on top-left edge, darker bronze bottom-right edge, slim charcoal outer shadow.

No text, letters, numbers, icons, symbols, runes, ornament, finials, bolts, illustrations, map, wood, luminous glow, decorative corner pieces, perspective, or other UI elements. Restraint: one extremely thin muted gold stroke around dark teal face, not a thick bevel or multiple borders.
